items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: And I played accompaniment for him when he taught singing.

ctx.x: I went and bought the books and taught myself. So you did have some teaching but through books? Through experience and learning.

Yeah. And just got the books, I got chord construction, chord construction and analysis by Gibbs. And I just started from there. And then I had some wonderful experience for five years with Paul Jacobs. Paul Jacobs was nine years in the San Carlos Opera Company. And I played accompaniment for him when he taught singing. Mm-hmm. I had to learn through Paul Jacobs to, to transpose and play in all different keys on the same tune. And I had to drop a half a step by just the sign that he gave me without saying a word.…
Well, so you, but you did pick up reading then of course, that you did that to an extent.
